name: Copperleaf Town
chat: Things fall into Copperleaf every week or so. We put the furniture to good use.
The flower on the knoll makes the power. The moss makes the roofs. The bees make the rest.
Hazel’s lab hums all night. Granny Juniper says it’s thinking.

props.label: Professor Hazel’s lab

people.name: Granny Juniper
script: [happy] There you are, dear. Up and about already? You came down in my lavender. Flattened half of it. #l:478f
Hazel looked you over and says you’ll live. I’ve made up the little room in my cottage. It’s yours for as long as you want it. #l:30c5
Come in whenever you like. Have a rest, and your Billies will feel better for it too. #l:0f7a
- [happy] Honey’s in the jar by the door. Don’t tell the bees I said so. #l:24d4
- Hazel works too hard. Take her some honey if you’re passing the lab. #l:96b8
- The wind sail turns all day and keeps the lanterns lit all night. Copper, sun and a bit of wind: that’s all a village needs. #l:5a4c
- Things fall into Copperleaf every week or so. Mostly furniture. You’re the first one I’ve kept. #l:f1c5
- [happy] You’ve been walking! I can tell. You’ve got that Hollow Earth colour in your cheeks. #l:187a
- The bees know everyone in Copperleaf. They’ll get used to you. #l:9126
